scope: Saturated, unshadowed, monomorphic direct self calls in declaration tail position through if, let-body and match-alternative branches.
transformation: A mutable tuple carries parameters between loop iterations. Every new argument uses ordinary expression emission in the same order and all arguments are evaluated before assigning the tuple. Each iteration introduces fresh immutable parameter bindings. Returning branches break with the ordinary emitted value; tail self calls assign the tuple and continue.
bindingRules: Declaration parameters, let binders and match binders shadow global function names. The source identifier encoder reserves the internal state namespace. Generic type applications, arity mismatches, nested lambda bodies and non-tail occurrences are not rewritten.
unchangedPaths: indirect self calls through decreasing-worker aliases
limits: Detection and emission use decreasing fuel. Ordinary expression errors and emission fuel exhaustion remain errors; no unsupported case is asserted to be validated.
focusedEvidence: Lean classifier/emitter and existing Rust source cases pass. Actual emitted code and native regression bodies pass Rust metadata type checking. Native cloud regressions check 100000-plus iterations, swapping arguments, shadowed parameters and matching a 30000-node chain. Execution/fixed-point outcomes are recorded separately in AI_WORK_STATE.md.
semanticBoundary: Uses existing immutable runtime-value semantics. External callback/destructor observability and foreign ABI behavior are not added to that contract. No stack-size increase, unsafe code, profile relaxation or general preservation claim.
